title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: view two shared screens side by side in meetings
summary: The roadmap facts and the documented control paths and automation check out. Hold for three unsupported assurances about unchanged data access, unchanged identity behaviour and the absence of autonomous actions: Microsoft describes the planned display experience but does not state those guarantees.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: No room-level or tenant-level UI or automation switch for this specific room layout feature is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms multiple screen shares setting XML Pro Management portal AllowMultipleScreenshare admin center. Opened device-settings-available, xml-config-file, pro-portal-settings and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; no room-layout switch found.

claims.claim: An admin UI control for Multiple Screenshare meeting options is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "AllowMultipleScreenshare" "admin center". Opened meeting-policies-content-sharing and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; found the PowerShell parameter but no corresponding admin UI path.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell documents Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowMultipleScreenshare $false.
claims.quote: [-AllowMultipleScreenshare <Boolean>] ... $false: MultiVBSS meeting options are not available (hidden) for the organizer.

claims.claim: AllowMultipleScreenshare controls whether Multiple Screenshare meeting options are available to organisers, at tenant or user scope.
claims.quote: It controls whether Multiple Screenshare is on or off for the entire tenant or for a particular user.

claims.claim: AllowMultipleScreenshare defaults to True.
claims.quote: ### -AllowMultipleScreenshare ... | Default value: | True |

claims.claim: The reference says AllowMultipleScreenshare currently has no effect because the feature has not been fully released.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The AllowMultipleScreenshare parameter description does not mention Teams Rooms or document control over room layouts.
claims.quote: Searched: "AllowMultipleScreenshare" "admin center"; Teams Rooms multiple screen shares setting XML Pro Management portal AllowMultipleScreenshare admin center. Opened Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and read AllowMultipleScreenshare: no Teams Rooms or room-layout applicability stated.

claims.claim: Screen sharing mode is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Content sharing > Screen sharing mode.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit. ... Go to the Content sharing section. ... These settings are described in the Screen sharing mode ... sections

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ScreenSharingMode Disabled prohibits screen sharing for the policy's users.
claims.quote: Determines the mode in which a user can share a screen in calls or meetings. ... Set this to Disabled to prohibit the user from sharing their screens.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Screen sharing mode is a per-user policy governing whether presenters can share desktops and windows in Teams meetings.
claims.quote: This setting is a per-user policy. The setting controls whether a user can share a desktop and window in a Teams meeting.

claims.claim: Screen sharing mode controls the ability to share screens, rather than the layout used to display received shares.
claims.quote: Entire screen: Full desktop sharing and application sharing are allowed in the meeting. ... Not enabled: Screen sharing and application sharing turned off in the meeting.

claims.claim: A device's dual monitor setting is at Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Rooms > device > Settings > Device > Dual monitor mode.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms on Windows: In the Pro Management portal, go to Settings > Device > Dual monitor mode.

claims.claim: Setting the DualScreenMode element in SkypeSettings.xml to true enables dual screen mode.
claims.quote: | <DualScreenMode> | Boolean ... | If true, dual screen mode is enabled. Otherwise the device uses single screen mode. |

claims.where: controls[3].note; Why it matters; Scope: Displays
claims.claim: Dual Monitor mode is disabled by default.
claims.quote: | Dual Monitor mode | Toggle | Disabled by default. | Dual screen mode is enabled. Otherwise, the device uses single screen mode.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap description names no new sign-in, permission, room account or data-access capability.
claims.quote: Participants can switch between side-by-side and expanded views, identify presenters for each screen, and benefit from layouts optimized for single or dual displays. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.claim: This feature does not change data access or handling.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "multiple screen shares" "data". Read roadmap, rooms-release-note and room-planning-guidance; none states that this planned feature leaves data access or handling unchanged.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with: 'For room service owners, the roadmap describes a change to what people see on the front-of-room displays.' This removes the unsupported data and identity assurances without changing the advice.

claims.claim: This feature does not change identity behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "multiple screen shares" "identity" permissions. Read roadmap, rooms-release-note and rooms-licensing; none guarantees unchanged identity behaviour for this feature.
claims.fix: Use the same replacement for the first sentence: 'For room service owners, the roadmap describes a change to what people see on the front-of-room displays.' Keep the narrower, supported statement in Security & identity that the roadmap names no new sign-in, permission or account.

claims.claim: The feature takes no action of its own.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "multiple screen shares" autonomous actions. Read roadmap, rooms-release-note and room-planning-guidance; none explicitly rules out autonomous actions for this feature.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the feature displays content and takes no action of its own.' with 'The roadmap describes displaying shared screens and switching views; it names no autonomous actions.'
